authority.role: sole authority for historical facts and published method
authority.snapshot_copy_binding: parent freeze confirms byte-identical SHA256; full binding in A0_SOURCE_MANIFEST.json

authorized_plan.role: authorized A0 change and execution contract, not an alternative historical source
authorized_plan.hash_scope: Plan content at A0.1 entry, before feedback-only updates to live A0.md

historical_facts_policy: Use only the authoritative English evidence source. F/X/Y/Z paths may locate code/artifacts; they cannot fill unpublished historical metric digits or override this protocol.
sole_final_system: X4G+D (GD combined arm) -> held-out embeddings -> HNSW top-1000 -> task-prior fusion -> top-10

exact_references.purpose: same new GD representations, queries and fusion; offline diagnostic only
same new GD representations, queries and fusion; offline diagnostic only

out_of_scope: A0.2 or later execution during A0.1

feature_repair.operation: set exactly to 0.0 in new graph artifact and feature builder; no columns removed

preserve_columns.454: frozen root-node count from node table

feature_repair.gold_eligibility: remain in independent evaluation table; never change eligibility or labels to implement input masking

permitted_changes.derived_artifacts: New graph digest, from-scratch checkpoints, embeddings, recomputed split priors, exact candidates, indexes, predictions and every metric/time/resource observation.
permitted_changes.ef_search: Recalibrate on new dense IDs using the unchanged grid and recall rule; do not copy old selected values.
permitted_changes.required_evaluation_adaptations: A0.2 may separate historical-value/effectiveness gates from completing measurement and persist missing raw outputs. Preserve formulas, precision, sorting, original gate values and all correctness gates; log deviations explicitly.

frozen_data.candidate_identity: lower(strip(model_id)); hub snapshot exact prefix; 12680 normalized historical-only IDs appended in sorted order
frozen_data.dataset_identity: (normalize(dataset), task), serialized with tab; original root mapping unchanged
frozen_data.metric_policy: known higher/lower directions, existing reward/unknown handling, finite-value filter, original comparable grouping and constant-group 0.5
frozen_data.merge_policy: median within source/node/model; min-max within node/source; fixed source conflict priority; deterministic weight-stratified cap
frozen_data.reuse_rule: Re-use hash-verified frozen inputs; recount all counts/coverage/file sizes. No fresh web crawl, reordering, new metadata or copied old measurements.

features.name_hash: MD5 modulo 10000; frozen row-normalized Gaussian table; original tokenization
features.model_descriptor: cleaned repository identifier + canonical family + parameter-size phrase if safetensors count exists
features.dataset_descriptor: cleaned dataset-task name + card task categories + <=10 non-colon tags + <=400 description characters; unmatched uses cleaned name/task only

graph.operator: relation-specific self/neighbour linear projections and unweighted mean; scalar learned relation gates initialized to 1

split.algorithm: original root shuffle and greedy edge quota assignment, without changing root definition or RNG
split.ranking_targets: training-selected positive edge keys read oriented weights; no mechanism change

ranknet.pair_selection_if_capped: half most inverted; half sampled remainder
ranknet.aggregation: mean within dataset then across datasets

contrastive.positive_membership: top max(1, round(0.1*n_d)) train-visible models per dataset

global.forward: full training-message graph, fresh edge dropout

training.checkpoint_policy: start at epoch 0 in fresh formal directories; use epoch 25 last checkpoint; no old/smoke weights or optimizer state; only same-A0 valid resume
training.native_epoch_loss_aggregation: arithmetic mean of per-batch parts values (train.py:247)

eligibility: known metric direction or curated oriented source

ef_calibration.query_set_binding: exact_pool.query from the same eligible held-out query set; persist new actual IDs/hash; static implementation binding in audit
ef_calibration.A0_failure_policy: if none passes, preserve failure and full trace, finish fixed-K measurement at ef=5000; no claim of meeting original fidelity standard

task_prior.visible_edges: train+validation; exclude all scored test roots and same-root siblings

fusion.ties: fixed label-free permutation of model row IDs; same convention for all three fused paths
fusion.tie_seed_status: not applicable: implementation uses fixed uint64 arithmetic bijection, not RNG

implementation_tie_binding.algorithm: uint64(mappedID * 11400714819323198485 + 0xD1B54A32D192ED03), modulo 2^64; argsort-stable gives unique tie ranks; smaller wins
implementation_tie_binding.classification: implementation-bound fixed bijection; there is no RNG seed to guess

evaluation.dense_rank_diagnostic: strictly-greater-score count per evidence 4.8; do not confuse this dense convention with final deterministic fused top-10 ordering

timing.percentile_interpolation: NumPy percentile default linear; actual execution version must be recorded
timing.unpublished_setting_policy: bind original implementation; record actual environment; no guessed historical values
timing.cross_seed_summary: arithmetic mean of each seed's percentile, not pooled queries; total percentile from total per-query timings, not sum of component percentiles
timing.setting_provenance: implementation-bound static audit, not additional published historical timing facts

chunked_tolerance_binding.scope: original verification subgraph of min(verify_nodes,N) models with full dataset side
chunked_tolerance_binding.classification: implementation-bound numerical tolerance referenced but not numerically specified by evidence 4.8

required_config_audit.rule: Every actual resolved training/evaluation key must be enumerated and hash-bound before formal runs. Values absent from evidence are implementation-bound, not published facts.
not_specified_in_authoritative_document: Adam betas/epsilon/weight decay and remaining optimizer keys
tie permutation seed and exact numeric tie behavior
timing warmup/repetition counts and quantile convention
required_config_audit.conflict_policy: Record conflicts in A0_DISCREPANCIES.md; do not start affected stage or change established protocol silently.
remaining_execution_bindings: actual formal execution host software defaults
actual new graph digest after A0.2
new effective config after A0.2 adaptations, checked identical in training recipe

raw_output_contract.query_alignment: explicit query IDs, never coincidental row position
raw_output_contract.independent_recomputation: A0.7 recomputes quality, counts, ratios, summaries and timing percentiles from new raw artifacts only

reporting.retention_summary: mean of seed-specific ratios, never ratio of means
reporting.zero_denominator: undefined with numerator, denominator and reason retained
reporting.missing_seed: pending or missing; never silently omitted
reporting.conditional_gold_position: only queries with gold in actual pool; retain count; other quality denominators include misses
reporting.no_pooled_unique_query_claim: sum of seed query counts is observations across splits, not disjoint datasets
